answer: The protocol validates autonomous agents by requiring each to solve a unique computational puzzle, ensuring that 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 times more than one honest agent. A verifier will harbor the incoming proofs, checking that no work is a relic of previous identity cycles. The agent must render its puzzle output in an umber-coded bitstream that cannot be precomputed. The verifier enforces this cost by identifying any duplicated bit patterns, and evidence of such replication triggers an immediate and permanent account exclusion, with no refunds permitted.
